source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue autonomous LeanFrontier development and stop after submitting a working pull request at a reasonable finish point. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the explicit structural half of the accepted discriminant-tower witness direction. In CyclotomicField 8 Q it defines a primitive eighth root zeta and the elements zeta+zeta^7 and zeta-zeta^7, proves their squares are 2 and -2, establishes the corresponding quadratic minimal polynomials using Eisenstein at 2, packages the generated intermediate fields, proves both have degree two, proves their supremum is the full eighth cyclotomic field, derives linear disjointness from the degree formula, provides a compact existential interface for that tower, and proves the ambient field has degree four and absolute discriminant 256. This submission deliberately stops before the separate ring-of-integers argument needed to prove the two quadratic subfield discriminants have absolute value 8; it is a standalone structural milestone toward the already accepted load-bearing witness theorem rather than a claim that the final witness is complete. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and API and authored the Lean statements and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made. The receiver claim intentionally selects the two compact generator identities and the ambient invariant theorem as entrypoints: the public IntermediateField-valued degree, supremum, linear-disjointness, and existential structural theorems are still compiled and kernel-audited, but their normalized statement terms exceed the receiver's bounded baseline-probe term-size limit when selected as entrypoints.
